The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B escort frigate]] '''''Serpent''''' and the Frigate ''[[Ruhger]]'' battled in the [[Greater Plooriod Cluster]]. She had a squadron of Tie Bombers and was destroyed by the Ruhger, aided by her Y-Wings and transports.
